steps.title: How many rows in categories?
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) answers 'how many rows?' with one number.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM categories;

steps.title: Count the id values
steps.prompt: COUNT(column) counts rows where that column is not empty (it skips NULLs).
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(id) FROM categories;
steps.memory_trick: COUNT(column) skips NULLs; COUNT(*) skips nothing.

steps.title: Count the name values
steps.prompt: COUNT(column) counts rows where that column is not empty (it skips NULLs).
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(name) FROM categories;
steps.memory_trick: COUNT(column) skips NULLs; COUNT(*) skips nothing.

steps.title: SUM of id
steps.prompt: SUM id: add up the values.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT sum(id) FROM categories;

steps.title: AVG of id
steps.prompt: AVG id: work out the average.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT avg(id) FROM categories;

steps.title: MIN of id
steps.prompt: MIN id: find the smallest value.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT min(id) FROM categories;

steps.title: MAX of id
steps.prompt: MAX id: find the biggest value.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT max(id) FROM categories;
